title: CUTLINE theme (version 1)
description: A CUTLINE theme file. With "base", every colour, font and metric is optional and inherits from the built-in Dark or Light theme. Without "base", every required colour must be present.

version.title: Format version
version.description: Theme format version. This schema is version 1.

name.title: Name
name.description: 1-40 characters. Can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | or control characters, and can't be "Dark", "Light" or "Match System" (any capitalisation).

base.title: Base theme
base.description: Built-in theme to inherit every value you leave out from.

window.title: Window background
window.description: Behind all panels and in the gaps between them.

panel.title: Panel background
panel.description: The main background of every panel.

panelRaised.title: Raised surface
panelRaised.description: Menus, headers, tab strips, toolbars and track headers.

divider.title: Divider
divider.description: The 1px lines between panels and rows.

pressed.title: Pressed
pressed.description: Background of pressed or switched-on controls.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Selected rows and selected text. Usually the accent with transparency (#AARRGGBB).

viewerSurround.title: Viewer surround
viewerSurround.description: Around the video in the viewer. Keep it a dark neutral grey so colours are judged correctly.

textMuted.title: Muted text
textMuted.description: Labels, secondary text and inactive tabs.

textOnAccent.title: Text on accent
textOnAccent.description: Text drawn on top of the accent colour.

timecodeDim.title: Timecode leading zeros
timecodeDim.description: The dimmed leading zeros in timecode displays.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Selection marks, the active tab, focus and the logo's cut line.

accentHover.title: Accent hover
accentHover.description: The accent under the mouse pointer.

focusRing.title: Focus ring
focusRing.description: Keyboard focus outlines and the focused panel's top line.

icon.title: Icons
icon.description: Icon colour on tool buttons. Optional: defaults to Muted text.

clipVideo.title: Video
clipVideo.description: Video track markers and video clips.

clipAudio.title: Audio
clipAudio.description: Audio track markers and audio clips.

clipTitle.title: Titles
clipTitle.description: Title and text clips (used from the effects preview onwards).

clipGenerator.title: Generators
clipGenerator.description: Generated clips such as solid colours (used from the effects preview onwards).

playhead.title: Playhead
playhead.description: The playhead line and its marker on the ruler. Optional: defaults to Accent.

waveform.title: Waveform
waveform.description: Audio waveforms inside clips (used from the import preview onwards). Optional: defaults to Audio.

danger.title: Danger
danger.description: Errors and destructive actions. Always shown with an icon and words too.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Warnings in the status bar and dialogs.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: Font family names only (never paths, URLs or font data). If the family isn't installed, CUTLINE uses its bundled Inter / JetBrains Mono.

ui.title: Interface font
ui.description: Menus, panels and dialogs. Default: Inter.

mono.title: Timecode font
mono.description: Timecode and rulers. A monospaced family works best. Default: JetBrains Mono.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: Corner radius of buttons, fields and menus in pixels. Default: 3.

density.title: Density
density.description: Multiplies spacing and row heights (not text size). 0.8 = compact, 1.25 = roomy. Default: 1.
